sections.name: The Marvelous import you allowed at 14:56 cannot start: the computer-use permission box declined three times (14:37, 15:19 and 15:25, the last while you were at the PC). Either do the import yourself in Marvelous (open now): File, Import (Add), DNA; pick head.dna and body.dna in F:\LedgerTools\bodies\MH_TomL1\dna\MH_TomL1\MH_TomL1; centimetres, 100%; automatic options left on; OK; then tap Done. Or check that computer use is on in the Claude app (Settings, This computer, Computer use) and tap Try again.
sections.recommendation: Do it yourself: about 2 minutes, and it does not depend on the permission box. No web link: the answer is this page.
